legal.scope: frozen official source selection and custom checked adapter; CUDA toolkit/driver retain their own licenses

input.source_domain: finite normal values or positive zero

semantics.bound_domain: finite normal positive dtype value and finite 0.5/bound reciprocal
semantics.f32_bound_policy: round downward to exactly representable normal f32
semantics.quality_policy: strict full reconstruction verification against requested bound on every trial; upstream claim alone is insufficient
semantics.wire: CSP1 version 1 + SHA-256 metadata and payload
semantics.independent_decode: persisted dtype/count/actual-bound/native payload; fresh independent session

boundaries.host_to_host: independent session lifecycle, source/wire preflight, CUDA allocation and control initialization, H2D, genuine kernel, completion, D2H, hashes/packing and checked release
boundaries.device_to_device: completed prepared input to completed payload owner; independently installed payload to completed decoded owner; preparation/install/materialization/release separately charged
boundaries.encode_event: control zero + H2D on host path + genuine kernel + size/rate D2H

resources.encode_owned_peak_capacity_bytes: payload_capacity + control_scratch + raw_input_bytes on host path (device input owner excluded)
resources.peak_scope: successfully requested capacities of adapter-owned CUDA buffers; excludes CUDA context/library/driver caching and other processes
resources.gpu_budget_policy: no strict driver/device allocation cap provided; explicit unsupported cap must reject admission

qualification.required_evidence: actual loaded GPU binary, CUDA device/runtime identity, strict host/device and fresh-process reconstruction, staged native rejection and balanced checked resource diagnostics
qualification.eligibility: extension is usable only after runtime availability and per-input source/quality checks; source card alone does not admit trials
